open_definitions.note: Gain/loss tolerances and typical operating screens require validation at actual supply, temperature and loading.

Budget levels include the combined signal; detection SNR tracks the wanted rf_in input. Waveforms add coherently and the ADC clips. Analytical levels use phase-averaged powers and independent noise, without predicting leakage sidelobes, coherent cancellation, or analog compression distortion.
Ideal quantization; engineering RMS signal threshold. Leakage, DC offset, jitter and measured ENOB are not modeled.
White uncorrelated noise and one-ramp acquisition; detection uses the selected FFT block threshold.
Linear signal propagation; compression limits flag violations without modeling distortion. LO drive checks are static; phase noise and settling are not propagated into detection.
